info.title: API.SH: Jiji
info.description: The Jiji API from API.SH: public Jiji data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The category tree of a country site with live listing counts: id, name, slug (the category parameter of /jiji/v1/search) and subcategories; `parent` returns one branch.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jiji-categories

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: A category slug or id to list its subcategories (e.g. `vehicles`).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site: ng (default), ke, gh, ug, tz or et.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The Jiji country sites this API reads, with their code (the `country` parameter of every other Jiji endpoint), name, currency and site address.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jiji-countries

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every filter of a category as the site's search shows it: key (use it in /jiji/v1/search filters or ranges), label, type, unit, range bounds and presets with counts, and the possible values with listing counts (e.g. every car make). Pass `filters` to get dependent values (e.g. the models of one make).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jiji-filters

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category slug from /jiji/v1/categories.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Already chosen values as `key:value;key2:value` (e.g. `filter_attr_1_make:Toyota` to get its models).

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: A region id from /jiji/v1/regions to count values in one region.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site: ng (default), ke, gh, ug, tz or et.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Pass values as filters=key:value|value;key2:value to /jiji/v1/search, and range keys as ranges=key:min-max.

get.description:
One classified listing: title, full description (phone numbers masked), price and price type (negotiable, fixed), the site's market price range and valuation, category and breadcrumbs, region, every attribute the seller filled in, all photos, posting, creation and moderation dates, views, favorites, status, promotion and the seller (name as the site shows it, public id, shop flag; listings count, feedback count, time on Jiji, last seen, verification labels). Seller phone numbers are never returned. `latest=true` returns the newest listing of a category.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jiji-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing code (24 characters, e.g. `tL7jEzjicXwAyfjll3BnhQ1s`), numeric listing id or a Jiji listing link (country taken from the link). Required unless latest=true.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the newest listing of `category` (default cars).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: With latest=true: a category slug from /jiji/v1/categories.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site: ng (default), ke, gh, ug, tz or et.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jiji's own asking-price statistics, month by month for the past year: number of listings and average, minimum and maximum asking price (local currency and USD) for a region and category, mostly property (e.g. houses and apartments for rent in Lagos).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jiji-price-statistics

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region slug from /jiji/v1/regions (e.g. `lagos`).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug (e.g. `houses-apartments-for-rent`, `houses-apartments-for-sale`, `land-and-plots-for-sale`).

parameters.name: attr_value_id
parameters.description: An attribute value id the site uses to narrow the statistics (e.g. number of bedrooms), as found in raw.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site: ng (default), ke, gh, ug, tz or et.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jiji-regions

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: A region slug or id to list the areas inside it (e.g. `lagos`).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site: ng (default), ke, gh, ug, tz or et.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search classified listings on one Jiji country site (cars, property, phones, electronics, fashion, jobs, services and every other category) with every filter the site's search accepts: keyword, category, region, price range, any category attribute (make, model, condition, transmission, bedrooms...), numeric ranges (year, mileage, size...), posting period and sort. Each listing comes with title, price, category, region, key attributes, a description snippet, main image, image count, labels (verified ID, years on Jiji), promotion and the seller's id. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jiji-search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keyword (e.g. `iphone 13`). Give a query or a category.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category slug from /jiji/v1/categories (e.g. `cars`, `mobile-phones`, `houses-apartments-for-rent`).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site: ng (Nigeria, default), ke (Kenya), gh (Ghana), ug (Uganda), tz (Tanzania) or et (Ethiopia).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: A region slug from /jiji/v1/regions (e.g. `lagos`, `ikeja`).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Category attributes as `key:value|value;key2:value`, keys and values from /jiji/v1/filters (e.g. `filter_attr_1_make:Toyota|Honda;filter_attr_100_condition:Foreign Used`).

parameters.name: ranges
parameters.description: Numeric ranges as `key:min-max`, keys from /jiji/v1/filters with type range (e.g. `filter_attr_119_year_of_manufacture:2015-2020`).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price in the country's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price in the country's currency.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Only listings posted in the last hour, day, week or month.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: rel (recommended, default), new (newest), price (lowest first) or price_desc (highest first).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for the first request (later pages: use cursor).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
